description: This file contains functions and data structures for parsing and converting INI configuration files into internal Config objects, including type coercion and nested value setting.

methods.name: configFromIniFile
methods.description: Reads an INI file and converts its contents into a Config object.

methods.name: configsFromIniFile
methods.description: Reads an INI file with multiple sections and returns a Map of section names to Config objects.

methods.name: iniEntriesToConfig
methods.description: Converts INI entries into a Config object, coercing types and setting nested values.

methods.name: coerceToType
methods.description: Coerces a raw value to a specified LonghandType (string, number, boolean, string[], size).

methods.name: coerceIniValue
methods.description: Converts a string INI value to a number, boolean, or leaves as string based on content.

methods.name: setNestedValue
methods.description: Sets a nested value in an object based on a dot-separated path.
